Step 2 of #928 (anchors, tags and aliases in the `yaml` package) is committed and pushed to `develop` as 95a690fe. One slip: the commit message reads `Fixes none` instead of `Part of #928`.

- **What went in:** I applied run 2's finished work (branch `wip/y2c-properties`, b223f972) onto today's `develop`. That is `packages/yaml/src/main.nika`, the new test `tests/anchors_tags_aliases.nika` with its `.stdout`, and the ledger files the test run rewrote (`nikaia.contracts`, `nikaia.derived`, `nikaia.lock`).
- **#1015 is fixed:** `nikaia fmt` reformatted `main.nika`, and the result still parses and passes `nikaia check`. This is what stopped run 2.
- **Tests:** `nikaia test --project packages/yaml` passes 11 of 11, including the new test. The other gate check, `fmt::every_nika_file`, passes too, so the gate is green. The binary was already current; the pre-flight build did nothing.
- **Commit message:** I wrote `Fixes: none` in the report, and `scripts/commit.nika` prints any `Fixes:` value that isn't empty and then skips `Part:`. A pushed commit can't be amended. It closes nothing (only `Fixes #N` closes an issue), but #928 needs a hand link to the commit. `commit.nika` could skip `Fixes: none` the way it already skips `Body: none`; that file is outside this lane, so I left it alone. Both points are under `Needs:` in the report.
- **Changelog:** none; the change is only under `packages/yaml/`.
- **Disk:** nothing freed. The test cache `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 6.1 GB and 8.2 GB is free on `/`. No new cache entry is over 100 MB.
